retrievalProfile.description: A central planetary sphere containing a row of realistic painted portraits against a dark, starry void.

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, detailed globe of Earth floats in a black star-filled space, with a horizontal row of six realistic, painterly male portraits integrated into the lower half of the sphere, their shoulders blending into the clouds and oceans.
coreVisualRelationships: Portraits are nested within the lower hemisphere of the globe
The globe is centered against a dark, speckled starfield
Typography is stacked and centered above the globe
The color palette transitions from the deep black of space to the blues and whites of the planet
coreInvariants: Circular planetary frame for the subjects
Deep black negative space surrounding the central element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The globe occupies the central 70% of the frame; portraits span the full width of the globe's lower half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central face in the portrait row acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold title at the top, down to the globe, and across the row of faces from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black space at the top and bottom corners emphasizes the celestial theme.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm flesh tones and brown hair (Portraits)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark void and the brightly lit, saturated planet.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight slab serif with decorative flourishes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a high crossbar with a triangular counter
The 'R' has a wide, curved leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative family with varying scales for title and subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 1970s rock aesthetic and heavy weight
Captures the internal white space details of the lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a painterly oil-style illustration of the Earth floating in a black starfield. The lower half of the Earth should feature a row of six realistic male faces with 1970s hairstyles, their necks and shoulders blending into the blue and white textures of the planet.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered, heavy decorative slab-serif text in white at the top of the frame. The top line should be larger than the second line.

verificationChecks: Are the faces integrated into the globe texture?
Is the background a deep black starfield?
Is the typography centered and heavy in weight?

adjustableVariables: Number of faces in the row
Specific continent visibility on the globe
mustRedesign: Avoid exact replication of the specific band members' likenesses
Do not use the specific record label logo in the corner

mustAchieve: Seamless blending between portraits and planetary clouds

postGenerationChecks: Check that the globe is perfectly circular
Ensure the text is legible against the black background
Verify the painterly style is consistent across all faces
Confirm the starfield does not overwhelm the central subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Central planetary sphere + integrated row of painterly portraits + heavy decorative slab typography + dark starfield background.
